title: recap_meta
description: YouTube title, description and hashtags for a recap, written by scripts/recap_meta.py from the workspace edit.json and the deterministic facts the tool builds (brief text, place, date, shot descriptions). The web app's Recap tab shows the fields with a Copy button each and hints at the facts missing from the brief.

generated_at.description: UTC timestamp the file was written

tool.description: the script that wrote the file, e.g. scripts/recap_meta.py

title.description: the YouTube title, at most 100 characters

description.description: the YouTube description, 2-3 sentences, at most 1000 characters

missing.description: facts the brief did not carry (e.g. 'place name', 'date'); the web app hints at them

llm_cost_usd.description: USD the model calls of this run cost
